name: kali-mcp
description: Provides an MCP interface to a full Kali Linux environment running in Docker, enabling AI assistants to execute security tools like nmap, sqlmap, and metasploit. It allows users to start/stop the container, run shell commands, and transfer files for security testing and educational purposes.
